verdict.rationale: The H200 SXM is a data-center AI/HPC accelerator module. Its documentation covers only LLM inference, HPC, MIG and HBM3e memory, so consumer gaming upscaling and frame generation (DLSS/FSR) with broad game support is a wrong-axis question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the part ships DLSS or FSR. The generic mention of RTX rendering technologies in developer tooling is not about this card and does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support
